comment: One of the best professors I have ever had. Dr. Johnson just retired, so if you weren't lucky enough to take a class with him, I feel sorry for you.

Dr. Johnson is the best professor I have ever had. He always encourage us to think outside of the box and make questions that we can reflect on our whole life. He is also a great advisor for both education and personal problems and is really easy to reach out. I heard he is going to retire soon so make sure to get his class as soon as possible!!

take dr. johnson! He's an amazing professor and guy in general. I got preregistered for IPC and was nervous, but truly the class is great. a bit of reading, and the content is quite psych heavy, but no regrets about taking it. he even reached out to me to let me revise a paper for a better grade. I would most definitely take another class with him!

Take Dr. J!!!!!! Literally the BEST professor at UofR, even if you are not a communication major, still consider taking his class. I took FYS and SSIR with him, I had a really great experience in and out of class, he is really funny and leads a good discussion. He made me think about a lot of things in life that I have never thought about before.

Taking his FYS (Narrative of Id. and Relationship) helped me to think about my identity (who I am and why I'm like this) in a new way. I thought the readings for the class were super interesting; several of them were short stories. My particular class was extremely talkative and the high class participation enhanced the discussion quality.

Take Dr. Johnson!!! Seriously, just do it. He assigns a reasonable amount of work (some readings and about 2-3 papers during the semester). He is really fun and enthusiastic, and he cares so much about his students. He is always willing to help, both with in class material and even with personal/professional troubles. He's such a great professor!

Absolutely love and adore Dr. Johnson. Class made a real impact on my life and has helped me find who I am. The readings are typical of any class, but are more interesting than others. Lots of theory and stories that use the theory. Grading is straight forward. DO NOT MISS A QUIZ! The quizzes are based on the readings and are completely random.

Phenomenal professor, advisor, and person.  I have nothing but good things to say about him, and recommend him as your go-to guy for absolutely anything.  He is an inspiration and a light to all who know him, and an integral part of my love for this school.
The class is not extrememly time consuming. Quizzes are easy just do the reading! He likes people who ask new questions and think outside the box. It's not impossible to get an A if you do the work.
I heard he is definitely a nice guy! however, the class is kinda boring and its hard to get an A
Nice guy, but impossible to get an A
No Comments

AMAZING MAN!!! hes has an answer to every question, is willing to bend over backward to help you out, extremely friendly, easy to talk to, just an all around great guy-one of those people who can change your life for the better. (and, of course, he has the CUTEST kids)

He is the best professor ever!!...so funny!  interpersonal communication is a very interesting course that i think everyone in college should be required to take....S. Johnson is the best!!!! i love this guy
the greatest prof. in the history of the world.  seriously.
Amazing teacher and Guy overall--Incredibly intelligent, helpful, funny--take any and every class you can with him--he's awesome!!!
Best professor I've ever had!
The best professor at Richmond.  He cares about the material he is teaching and it shows.  I would highly recommend him for anyone interested in taking Rhetoric.
awesome prof!

Took lots of classes with him - and loved them all.  He made the material matter.  The assigments weren't pointless, but I actually remembered doing them and learned from them.  he's hysterical, and everyone needs to have him at least once.
amazing teacher - funny, great attitude, amazingly smart, you'll actually look forward to classes, can go to if you need any help at all

holy cow.  A great teacher.  Learned and laughed so much.  I will be thinking of dicscossions we had in that class for years and years to come.  The knowledge I required will stay with me for a lifetime
Dr. J actually cares about his students and will go the extra mile to help you out.  If you get on his good side, he will pick on you in class. He's a great teacher and very informative.
Classes are always entertaining, but don't always have much substance
Lot of fun and absolutely hilarious, great guy and wealth of knowledge, expert
